title: Recent Non-Warranty Visits and the Dispatch Charge: Billing Q&A, Calloway Limited Home Warranty
content:
The emergency dispatch charge under the Calloway Limited Home Warranty carries a non-warranty visit multiplier, applied to the program's emergency dispatch fee in the scheduled dispatch charge.

**Rule.** The non-warranty visit multiplier counts the reinspection charges and the emergency dispatch charges assessed on the coverage within the last 12 calendar months (dated later than the same calendar day 12 months before the assessment day): two or more take 1.50; exactly one takes 1.25; none takes 1.00, that is, no adjustment.

*Which charges are counted together?* Reinspection charges and emergency dispatch charges, both kinds added into one count. Missed-appointment charges are not part of this count.

*Where does the window start?* Assessed on 12 February 2026, the window takes charges dated 13 February 2025 or later.

| Reinspection charges in the window | Emergency dispatch charges in the window | Count | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0 | 0 | 1.00 |
| 1 | 0 | 1 | 1.25 |
| 0 | 1 | 1 | 1.25 |
| 1 | 1 | 2 | 1.50 |
| 2 | 0 | 2 | 1.50 |
